name: Dolanaar Delivery
summary: In Shadowglen, travelers carry herbs south to Dolanaar. Porthannius is busy with the druids, and the road beyond the sheltered glade opens before young adventurers.

sections.title: A Messenger for Shadowglen
sections.body: Porthannius asks travelers bound south from Shadowglen to carry freshly gathered herbs along the forest path. Pressing business with the druids tending the glade keeps him from making the journey himself. The bundle goes south as young adventurers leave the training grounds and set out into the wider reaches of Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Road to Dolanaar
sections.body: The southern road from Shadowglen reaches Dolanaar, a foremost night elf settlement on Teldrassil's great boughs. Innkeeper Keldamyr looks after rest, hospitality, and supplies for wanderers, sentinels, and druids. When he receives Porthannius's herbs, he urges young adventurers to rest their minds and spirits before facing the corruption spreading across the world tree.

faq.answer: Porthannius is a night elf who lives in Shadowglen, Teldrassil's starting glade. He works with the local druids and asks travelers leaving the glade to carry supplies south for him.

faq.q: Why can't Porthannius deliver the herbs himself?
faq.answer: Urgent business with Shadowglen's druids keeps Porthannius occupied in the sheltered vale, so he depends on passing adventurers to carry the herbs south.
The package holds herbs gathered in Shadowglen for use at the inn in Dolanaar.
Innkeeper Keldamyr manages Dolanaar's inn, offering travelers hospitality, lodging, and hearthstones. He also coordinates trade and supply exchanges with other settlements across Teldrassil.
Dolanaar lies south of Shadowglen. The main road from the glade's exit leads travelers straight to the town center.

faq.q: Why is this delivery important for young adventurers?
faq.answer: The delivery takes young adventurers beyond Shadowglen and introduces them to Dolanaar's inn, trainers, and service providers.

angles.text: As a night elf, you leave Aldrassil's protected cradle and take on broader responsibilities in safeguarding Teldrassil.
As a herbalist, you know raw herbs from Shadowglen's soil matter to Dolanaar's healers, cooks, and caretakers.
As a druid, you know Porthannius is occupied with Shadowglen's druids and the spiritual duties and natural imbalances that concern the Cenarion Circle among Teldrassil's boughs.
